verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph is a documented public API with a single endpoint (https://graph.microsoft.com), and its first-party reference documents Entra directory operations such as listing user objects, so the product can be driven programmatically. The evidence only explicitly shows user listing, so how much of Entra administration Graph covers is unproven. The OpenAPI probe 404s were on the Learn docs site, not on Graph, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: evidence of Graph coverage for broader Entra admin surfaces (Conditional Access, lifecycle workflows, entitlement management), a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.
